goal: Merge overlapping intervals given as a list of [start, end] pairs
assumptions: Input is a list of intervals, each interval is a list of exactly two integers [start, end].
An interval is considered valid if start <= end; invalid intervals (start > end) are ignored.
Intervals are closed on both ends: [1,3] and [3,5] overlap and merge to [1,5].
The input list may be empty; an empty list returns an empty list.
The input list may contain duplicate intervals; duplicates are merged into one.
The output is a list of merged intervals sorted by start time.
The function does not modify the input list.
The function returns a new list of lists of integers.
